title: Optimal Multi-bit Generative Watermarking Schemes Under Worst-Case False-Alarm Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2604.08759v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: This paper considers the problem of multi-bit generative watermarking for large language models under a worst-case false-alarm constraint. Prior work established a lower bound on the achievable miss-detection probability in the finite-token regime and proposed a scheme claimed to achieve this bound. We show, however, that the proposed scheme is in fact suboptimal. We then develop two new encoding-decoding constructions that attain the previously established lower bound, thereby completely characterizing the optimal multi-bit watermarking performance. Our approach formulates the watermark design problem as a linear program and derives the structural conditions under which optimality can be achieved. In addition, we identify the failure mechanism of the previous construction and compare the tradeoffs between the two proposed schemes.

translated_title: 最坏情形误警约束下的最优多比特生成式水印方案
translated_abstract: 本文研究了在最坏情形误警约束下，面向大语言模型的多比特生成式水印问题。先前的工作建立了有限词元情形下可实现的漏检概率的下界，并提出了一个声称能够达到该下界的方案。然而，我们证明该方案实际上是次优的。随后，我们提出了两种新的编码-解码构造，它们能够达到先前建立的下界，从而完整刻画了最优的多比特水印性能。我们的方法将水印设计问题表述为一个线性规划，并推导出能够实现最优性的结构条件。此外，我们还识别了先前构造的失效机制，并比较了所提出的两种方案之间的权衡。
tldr: 本文证明了大语言模型多比特生成式水印中现有方案是次优的，并提出两种能达到漏检概率理论下界的新型编码-解码构造，通过线性规划刻画了最优性条件，从而完整解决了最坏情形误警约束下的最优多比特水印设计问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that prior multi-bit generative watermarking schemes for LLMs are suboptimal and proposes two new encoding-decoding constructions achieving the miss-detection lower bound, completely characterizing optimal multi-bit watermarking performance under worst-case false-alarm constraints.
